about: Free lecture courses and reference sites for the AI courses. Watch and read to learn; never copy slides, text or figures. Check links with node scripts/ai-courses/verify-sources.mjs --links

courses.title: Stanford CS229: Machine Learning
courses.use: Lecture notes with full derivations (GLMs, SVMs, EM, learning theory).

courses.title: Stanford CS231n: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
courses.use: Backprop on computational graphs, CNNs; the best written notes for vision.

courses.title: Stanford CS224N: NLP with Deep Learning
courses.use: Word vectors to transformers and LLMs.

courses.title: Stanford CS236: Deep Generative Models
courses.use: VAEs, flows, GANs, diffusion, with derivations.

courses.title: Berkeley CS285: Deep Reinforcement Learning
courses.use: Policy gradients, actor-critic, Q-learning, model-based RL.

courses.title: David Silver: Introduction to Reinforcement Learning (UCL)
courses.use: The classic RL lecture series.

courses.title: MIT 18.06: Linear Algebra (Strang)
courses.use: Linear algebra the way engineers use it. OCW: CC BY-NC-SA.

courses.title: MIT 18.065: Matrix Methods in Data Analysis and ML
courses.use: SVD, low rank, gradient descent, the math of deep nets. OCW: CC BY-NC-SA.

courses.title: MIT 6.S191: Introduction to Deep Learning
courses.use: Short modern overview with labs.

courses.title: Karpathy: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
courses.use: Build micrograd, makemore and GPT from scratch: the model for our from-scratch labs.

courses.title: fast.ai: Practical Deep Learning
courses.use: Top-down practical deep learning.

courses.title: OpenAI Spinning Up in Deep RL
courses.use: Clean derivations and reference code (MIT) for policy-gradient methods.

courses.title: Hugging Face LLM Course
courses.use: Transformers in practice: tokenizers, fine-tuning, datasets.

courses.title: Distill (journal)
courses.use: Interactive explanations; articles are CC BY 4.0 (adapt with attribution). Our bar for visual quality.

courses.title: 3Blue1Brown: Neural networks series
courses.use: Visual intuition for nets, backprop, transformers. Inspiration only; we draw our own.

courses.title: GATE Data Science & AI (official syllabus)
courses.use: GATE DA exam: map our chapters to its syllabus so Indian students can prepare.

courses.title: Papers with Code (archive) / arXiv listings
courses.use: Where new papers appear; for keeping the course current.

courses.title: Stanford CS336: Language Modeling from Scratch
courses.use: Build an LLM end to end: tokenizer, transformer, GPU kernels, parallelism, data, alignment. The model for our systems course.

courses.title: Hugging Face: The Ultra-Scale Playbook
courses.use: Training on many GPUs, measured: data, tensor, pipeline, context and expert parallelism, ZeRO.

courses.title: How to Scale Your Model (Google DeepMind)
courses.use: Rooflines, sharding and the arithmetic of training and serving big transformers on TPUs and GPUs.

courses.title: NVIDIA CUDA C++ Programming Guide
courses.use: The official description of threads, blocks, warps, memory spaces and tensor cores.

courses.title: GPU MODE lectures
courses.use: Free lectures on writing GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton) for deep learning.

courses.title: nanoGPT (Karpathy)
courses.use: The smallest clear GPT training code (MIT licence): the reference for our build-a-GPT capstone.

courses.title: llm.c (Karpathy)
courses.use: GPT-2 training in plain C and CUDA (MIT licence): every kernel visible.

courses.title: Transformer Circuits Thread (Anthropic)
courses.use: Anthropic's published interpretability research: circuits, superposition, features.

courses.title: LLM Visualization (Bycroft)
courses.use: A 3D walk through a GPT's forward pass. Inspiration for our 3D model explorer only; we build our own.

courses.title: Python 3.15 documentation
courses.use: Official tutorial, language reference and standard library: the source for every Python lesson.

courses.title: NumPy 2.5 documentation
courses.use: Official user guide and API reference for arrays.

courses.title: pandas 3.1 documentation
courses.use: Official user guide and API reference for DataFrames.

courses.title: Matplotlib 3.11 documentation
courses.use: Official user guide and gallery for plotting.

courses.title: scikit-learn 1.9 documentation
courses.use: Official user guide for classical machine learning in Python.

courses.title: PyTorch 2.15 documentation
courses.use: Official API reference and tutorials for tensors, autograd and training.

courses.title: Pyodide documentation
courses.use: The in-browser Python the lessons run code with.
